video.preprocessing: uniform endpoint-inclusive frames within each causal window; resize-short-side, center crop 288, RGB float32 [0,1]; mean all output tokens to 768D

audio.preprocessing: decode mono 48kHz AAC by PyAV; resample to 16kHz; Whisper 30s log-mel; mean valid encoder tokens to 384D

sensor.source: official HoloAssist synchronized IMU archive; selected train/validation sessions only
sensor.bin_boundary: right-closed (start, end], with t=0 included in the recording's first bin
sensor.normalization: per-feature mean/std fit on train windows only; applied unchanged to validation; std floor 1e-6; clip to [-10,10]

arms.av: same architecture with the sensor path gated off
arms.sensor_only: same architecture with AV paths gated off

best_checkpoint_selector: lowest validation NLL; ties keep earliest step
training_sampling: uniform shuffled training sessions; each session used once per epoch
loss: unweighted cross entropy over labelled windows; natural prevalence retained
unlabelled_windows: retained as causal session-LSTM context; excluded from loss and metrics
validation: same frozen official-train-derived validation sessions and exact window IDs as AV baseline; no official validation/test or sealed audit payload loaded
comparisons: AV-only, sensor-only, and AV+sensor use identical training/validation windows, seed, optimizer schedule, evaluation intervals, and selector
scope: development-only HoloAssist error-detection task; no broad Omni-quality claim
